answer_1.quote: we tackle the task of canonical segmentation, which consists of segmenting a word while restoring the original forms of its morphemes. ... Inspired by recent advances in the area of morphological generation, we propose two new models for the task of low-resource canonical segmentation
answer_1.outputs: canonical segmentations of words with restored morpheme forms

answer_2.quote: For evaluation, we use three metrics. The first one is accuracy, i.e., the proportion of entirely correctly segmented words, to get a better understanding of partially right segmentation. To get more information about subword-level errors, we also employ edit distance on the character level. ... We also use F1 score on the morpheme level, to measure the overlap between morphemes
